# seerr_languages (Data Source)

Fetch supported ISO language codes from TMDB for language-filtered discover sliders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `languages` (Attributes List) List of languages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))
- `total` (Number) Total number of languages returned.

<a id="nestedatt--languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `languages`

Read-Only:

- `english_name` (String) English name of the language.
- `iso_639_1` (String) ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. `en`, `es`, `fr`).
- `name` (String) Native name of the language.
